تنتدبين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَدِبِينَ (tantadibīna) /tan.ta.di.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# تُنْتَدَبِينَ (tuntadabīna) /tun.ta.da.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
